user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by category so that I can focus on a specific area.

positive.title: Filter tasks by existing category
steps: Select a category from the category filter dropdown.
Click the 'Apply' button to filter tasks.
positive.expected_result: Tasks are filtered to show only those belonging to the selected category.

negative.title: Filter tasks by a non-existent category
steps: Enter a non-existent category name in the category filter input.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that no tasks match the non-existent category.

edge.title: Filter tasks with an empty category field
steps: Leave the category filter field empty.
Click the 'Apply' button to attempt filtering tasks.
edge.expected_result: All tasks are shown as no specific category has been selected for filtering.
